title: SQL Server Hierarchical Mock Data Generator
summary: A command-line tool that extracts SQL Server table schemas and generates realistic, constraint-respecting mock data (preserving keys, hierarchies, and uniqueness) for preview and insertion into a database. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and constraints module to learn from existing data and synthesize new rows.
evidence: scripts/generate_data.py:299-305 instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata=metadata) and fits it on sample data
